info.name: Griot — API Contract Suite (REST + GraphQL)
info.description: Official Griot Postman collection. Covers every route. Auth tokens and entity IDs chain automatically via test scripts. Run headlessly with Newman in CI (qa spec 05). All routes implemented — none return 501. Updated: 2026-09-10.

request.description: Public health check. No auth. Returns 200 Healthy.
Register alice (primary test user). 201 on first run, 409 on re-run (idempotent).
Authenticate alice. Rotates refresh token. 429 after 10 attempts/900s.
Register bob (second test user for invite/member flows).

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('memberId', j.user.id); pm.environment.set('memberToken', j.accessToken); }

request.description: Login bob to get memberToken.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('memberId', j.user.id); pm.environment.set('memberToken', j.accessToken); }

request.description: Exchange refresh token for a new pair. FamilyId preserved; reuse revokes family (401).

exec: if (skip) { console.log('SKIP: no refreshToken yet'); return; }
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('accessToken', j.accessToken); pm.environment.set('refreshToken', j.refreshToken); }

request.description: Request 6-digit OTP. Purposes: email_verify | login_2fa | password_reset. Rate-limited 3/900s per email.
Verify OTP. Replace code '000000' with actual 6-digit code from email for a 200 pass. 5 wrong attempts -> 429 lockout.
Authenticated logout. Idempotent: revokes refresh token. Returns 204.
Create workspace. Chains workspaceId into env.
List workspaces for authenticated user.
Get workspace by ID.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Schema ok', () => pm.expect(j).to.include.all.keys('id','name','slug','ownerId','members')); }

Create a 7-day invite token. Chains inviteToken into env.
Remove member from workspace. Owner only.
Inspect invite before accepting. Returns InviteDto or 404.
Accept invite as bob. Returns 200 on success or 409 if already member/expired.
Create project. Chains projectId into env.
List projects in workspace.
Get project by ID.
Update project fields.

Create board in project. Chains boardId into env.
List boards in project.
Get board by ID (includes columns).
Update board name/order.
Create column in board. Owner/Admin only. Chains columnId and targetColId.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('columnId', j.id); }

request.description: Create a second column for task-move testing. Chains targetColId.
Update column name/order/wipLimit. Owner/Admin only.

Delete board. Owner/Admin only. Returns 204.
